2025-08-18 06:40 PM EDT
Toronto Blue Jays      2    @
Pittsburgh Pirates     5

Alexander Canario singles on a line drive to center fielder Daulton Varsho. Nick Gonzales scores. Jared Triolo to 3rd.
Bottom 2 - Toronto Blue Jays: 0, Pittsburgh Pirates: 1

Vladimir Guerrero Jr. grounds out, third baseman Isiah Kiner-Falefa to first baseman Spencer Horwitz. George Springer scores.
Top 3 - Toronto Blue Jays: 1, Pittsburgh Pirates: 1

Bo Bichette singles on a line drive to right fielder Bryan Reynolds. Addison Barger scores.
Top 3 - Toronto Blue Jays: 2, Pittsburgh Pirates: 1

Bryan Reynolds reaches on a fielder's choice, fielded by first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Spencer Horwitz scores. Tommy Pham to 2nd.
Bottom 3 - Toronto Blue Jays: 2, Pittsburgh Pirates: 2

Liover Peguero walks.
Bottom 7 - Toronto Blue Jays: 2, Pittsburgh Pirates: 3

Henry Davis out on a sacrifice fly to center fielder Daulton Varsho. Alexander Canario scores.
Bottom 8 - Toronto Blue Jays: 2, Pittsburgh Pirates: 5
